nodes.name: Remove Duplicates
nodes.notes: Skips a Telegram redelivery when body.update_id was already seen. If update_id is absent, the execution id is the key so that delivery still runs once.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ analyticsEvent: 'incoming_message', chatId: $('Webhook').first().json.body?.message?.chat?.id ?? '', messageId: $('Webhook').first().json.body?.message?.message_id ?? '', updateId: $('Webhook').first().json.body?.update_id ?? '', loggedAt: $now.toISO() }) }}

nodes.name: Log Incoming Message
nodes.notes: Posts analytics for chatId, messageId, and updateId to $env.ANALYTICS_WEBHOOK_URL. Message text is not included. A failure continues to Start Command so the reply is still sent.

nodes.name: Load Chat Memory
nodes.notes: Builds the OpenAI messages array: the Telegram system prompt plus the last 10 user and assistant messages for this chat id. Does not run for /start or non-text.

nodes.name: Send to OpenAI
nodes.notes: HTTP POST to the OpenAI chat completions API with the OpenAI API credential. Runs only for non-empty text that is not /start. Model gpt-4o-mini, max_tokens 500, system prompt plus the last 10 chat messages. Retries twice with a 3 second wait. The error output goes to Prepare Error Log.

nodes.name: Save Assistant Memory
nodes.notes: Stores the assistant reply on the same chat id and sets output to that reply text for Send Telegram Reply. Message text is not sent to analytics or the administrator.

parameters.text: ={{ (String($('Webhook').first().json.body?.message?.text ?? '') === '' ? 'I can only read text messages for now.' : ($('Webhook').first().json.body?.message?.text === '/start' ? 'Hi! Send me a question and I will answer it.' : String($json.output ?? $json.choices?.[0]?.message?.content ?? $json.text ?? ''))).replace(/&/g, '&').replace(/</g, '<').replace(/>/g, '>') }}

assignments.name: userRetryText
assignments.value: Sorry, something went wrong. Please try again in a moment.

parameters.text: ={{ ['Chatbot failed (', $('Prepare Error Log').first().json.workflowName, ' / ', $('Prepare Error Log').first().json.stage, '): ', $('Prepare Error Log').first().json.errorMessage, ' | execution=', $('Prepare Error Log').first().json.executionId, ' at ', $('Prepare Error Log').first().json.at].join('').replace(/&/g, '&').replace(/</g, '<').replace(/>/g, '>') }}

parameters.errorMessage: ={{ 'Chatbot reply failed (' + String($('Prepare Error Log').first().json.stage ?? 'chatbot_reply_path') + '): ' + String($('Prepare Error Log').first().json.errorMessage ?? 'unknown error').slice(0, 200) }}

nodes.name: Ignore Non-Text
nodes.notes: Non-text updates (photo, voice, sticker, file) pass through here to Send Telegram Reply, which sends the text-only reply. OpenAI is not called.

parameters.content:
## Assumptions (JAW-9970)

- Assumption: the trigger stays this Webhook on POST /telegram with header auth (Telegram Webhook Secret), not a Telegram Trigger. Telegram fields are read from the webhook body.
- Assumption: the OpenAI model is gpt-4o-mini with max tokens 500. The call is an HTTP Request using the OpenAI API credential, 2 tries, 3 second wait, because the OpenAI node cannot retry while an error output is connected.
- Assumption: group-chat /ask gating and a private user allowlist are not applied. No bot username or allowed user ids were provided. Every chat uses the text, /start, and AI paths.
- Assumption: per-chat memory is the last 10 user and assistant messages in n8n workflow static data, keyed by chat id, and is sent on the OpenAI call. It is not an AI Agent window-buffer sub-node. Static memory survives a restart. Message text is not posted to the analytics webhook and is not included in the administrator alert.
- Assumption: errors stay inside this workflow. There is no separate error workflow. The user retry message is sent, then the administrator is alerted at TELEGRAM_ADMIN_CHAT_ID, then Stop and Error marks the run failed.
- Assumption: Telegram parse mode is HTML, ampersands and angle brackets are escaped, and attribution is off, so replies stay plain text.
- Assumption: each OpenAI attempt times out at 10 seconds. The workflow execution timeout stays 300 seconds so the two retries can finish. A successful answer is still expected in under 10 seconds when OpenAI responds promptly.
- Assumption: duplicate handling uses body.update_id. When update_id is missing, the execution id is the key so the sample payload is not dropped.
- Non-text reply text is: I can only read text messages for now. The /start reply is: Hi! Send me a question and I will answer it. The OpenAI failure reply is: Sorry, something went wrong. Please try again in a moment.
